title: 第3章 琉璃川的骑士第4章 琉璃川的六位骑士
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“伯爵大人下令，允许来自第戎的难民进入外城。”
佛丁干脆利落的转述了叶海的命令。
佛丁骑士长。”
门口的骑士在领命后也是迅速的开始下发命令：“你们几个把拒马都搬开，还有让外面的人排好队，一个一个来。”
城门口手持长矛身着皮甲的士兵们听到纷纷开始行动了起来，厚重的城门逐渐打开。
眼见手底下的士兵开始动起来了，这位看守城门的骑士这才好奇的凑到佛丁身旁小声问道：“佛丁老大，怎么今天您亲自来了，往常这种小事不都是随便派个传令兵就好了吗？”
“您难道不需要守护在伯爵大人身边了吗？”
“今天不是说那位琉璃川的大小姐要和伯爵大人商讨要事吗？难不成已经谈完了？”
“也是，是该谈完了，不然伯爵大人也不会下令放人进来了。”
佛丁瞥了一眼身旁这位碎嘴的小子说道：“塔林姆，你小子怎么现在也那么八卦了。”
“嘿嘿，佛丁老大，这不是天天站在城门口有些无聊了嘛。”
塔林姆尴尬的挠了挠脑袋，他作为守城官平日里除了下令开关门以外真的就是无事可做了。
具体的闲杂琐事自然是由下级去办，他就是纯粹望着城外放空大脑。
身为高级骑士的他至今没能摸到大骑士的门槛，修炼也是没了方向，可不就只能放空大脑祈求来一个顿悟么。
“哼，你这家伙。”
佛丁无奈的摇了摇头，虽然感觉塔林姆有些嘴碎，但毕竟是自己从小看到大的老伙计了，他还是开口说道：“从昨天开始，我们的伯爵大人恐怕就已经不需要我专门来守护他了。”
塔林姆听到这话瞳孔猛的一缩，随即脸上浮起了一抹喜色：“你的意思是，伯爵大人他已经……”
佛丁欣慰的点点头：“没错，伯爵大人他已经突破成为大骑士了，就像老伯爵当年一样是个天才。”
“不愧是传说中拥有巨龙血脉的家族，每一位大人都是如此的天赋异禀……”
塔林姆脸上不免露出了一丝羡白，目光不由得移到了城头上绣着巨龙的旗帜，这是枫叶家族的族徽与标记。
他自己已经年过三十了至今还卡在高级骑士动弹不得，而自己效忠的伯爵大人却在二十出头的年纪里达到了大骑士之境。
伯爵大人不愧是伯爵大人。
塔林姆此刻的内心满是敬佩之意。
不仅总是有有些天马行空的天才炼金产品，就连天赋都是那么的优异。
“弗森大人，枫叶城的守城官允许我们进城了。”
一张年轻却疲惫的脸出现在弗森的面前。
弗森，高级骑士，前琉璃川大公的亲卫骑士之一，也是护送琉璃川千代逃到枫叶城的最大助力。
“看来交易已经达成了。”
弗森同样有些疲惫，不过在自己的下属面前他绝对不能露出一丝怯懦。
他伸手扶了扶前来报信士兵头上的有些歪斜的头盔，然后站直了身体下令道：“所有人，准备进城。”
当初追随他们从第戎城逃出来的人何止上万，而这一路走来，现如今却只剩了这零零散散的不到两千人。
其中多数还是身强体壮的壮年，老弱则大多数在途中被远远的甩在后面。
或许之后还会有人陆陆续续的来到此地，但大多数没跟上人的命运恐怕……
弗森叹了口气，便走到一辆马车边上：“露娜夫人，我们可以进城了。”
“那便进去吧。”
content_en:
: "My lord the count has given an order to allow refugees from Dijon to enter the outer city."
Fording relayed Ye Hai's order simply and neatly.
"Yes!
Captain Fording. "
The knight at the door quickly began to issue orders after receiving the order: "You guys, move all the horses away, and ask the people outside to line up and come one by one."
The soldiers holding spears and wearing leather armor at the city gate began to take action when they heard it, and the heavy city gate gradually opened.
Seeing that the soldiers under his command began to move, the knight guarding the city gate came to Fording curiously and asked softly: "Boss Fording, why are you here in person today? Isn't it usually just a matter of sending a messenger for such trivial matters?"
"Don't you need to be by your side, Lord Earl?"
"Didn't I say today that the eldest lady of Liulicuan wants to discuss something important with the earl? Is it possible that the discussion has already been completed?"
"That's right, it's time to finish talking, otherwise the earl won't give the order to let people in."
Fording glanced at the talkative boy next to him and said, "Talim, why are you so gossiping now?"
"Hey, Boss Fording, isn't it a bit boring to stand at the city gate every day?"
Talim scratched his head in embarrassment. As a city guard, he really had nothing to do except order the doors to be opened and closed.
The specific trivial matters were naturally handled by the subordinates. He just looked outside the city to empty his mind.
As a senior knight, he has not been able to touch the threshold of a great knight, and his cultivation has no direction, so he can only empty his mind and pray for an epiphany.
"Hmph, you guy."
Fording shook his head helplessly. Although he felt that Talim was a little bit tongue-tied, after all, he was an old man whom he had grown up with. He still said: "Since yesterday, our Lord Earl probably no longer needs me to protect him."
Talim's pupils shrank sharply when he heard this, and then a smile appeared on his face: "You mean, Lord Earl, he has..."
Fording nodded happily: "Yes, Lord Earl, he has broken through and become a great knight. He is a genius just like the old Earl back then."
"As expected of the legendary family with dragon bloodline, every adult is so talented..."
Talim couldn't help but reveal a hint of envy on his face, and his eyes couldn't help but move to the flag embroidered with a giant dragon on the top of the city. This is the emblem and symbol of the Maple Leaf family.
He himself is over thirty years old and is still stuck as a senior knight, but the Earl to whom he is loyal has reached the realm of a great knight in his early twenties.
The Earl is indeed a Earl.
Talim's heart was full of admiration at this moment.
Not only are there always some unconventional genius alchemy products, but even the talents are so excellent.
…
"Lord Ferson, the defender of Maple Leaf City has allowed us to enter the city."
A young but tired face appeared in front of Ferson.
Fusen, a senior knight, was one of the personal bodyguard knights of the former Grand Duke Liulichuan. He was also the biggest helper in escorting Chiyo Liulichuan to Maple Leaf City.
"Looks like the deal is done."
Fosen was also a little tired, but he must not show a trace of cowardice in front of his subordinates.
He stretched out his hand to support the slightly skewed helmet on the head of the soldier who came to report the news, then stood up straight and ordered: "Everyone, prepare to enter the city."
There were more than tens of thousands of people who followed them to escape from the city of Dijon, but now there are only a scattered number of less than two thousand people left along the way.
Most of them are still strong and healthy, and most of them are old and weak and are left far behind on the way.
Maybe there will be people coming here one after another in the future, but most of them will not follow the fate of others...
"Alas..."
Ferson sighed and walked to a carriage: "Mrs. Luna, we can enter the city."
"..."
"Then go in."
